accepted_decisions.summary: Use graph/state as primary agent read/routing/resume index while canonical truth remains in KB, roadmap, builds, validation, code, tests, and Git proof.
Treat execution graph as planning/runtime lens in generated graph, not second canonical graph store.
Prioritize backend worker daemon scheduling over board/TUI UX; chat remains sufficient UI during backend refactor.
Introduce durable Brain lease semantics, worker question/block/unblock, run-scoped worker lifecycle, and model policy metadata before full parallel execution.
Adopt high-level wiki_<name> tool surface: wiki_state, wiki_decide, wiki_plan, wiki_implement, wiki_gate, and wiki_runtime.
Drop generic wiki_maintain; deterministic repair is automatic or targeted, semantic repair routes to correct compiler/gate.
Workflow tools should batch common operations, return compact envelopes, and support dry-run/preflight, idempotency, fingerprints, and recovery guidance.

Updated runtime with backend scheduling priority, Brain lease, run-scoped workers, durable escalation, question classes, and model policy.
Updated graph with graph-centered agent access, execution lens, and drift categories.
Updated roadmap/compiler contracts with planning-owned execution graph metadata indexed by graph/runtime.
Updated adapter/build/agency/worktree/control-room/file-structure/change-lifecycle docs from codewiki_* tool names to wiki_<name> tool names where they described agent-facing tools.
Updated product drift story from codewiki_state to wiki_state.

assumptions: Chat remains sufficient UI while backend scheduling is built.
Current low-level tools remain available for compatibility/debug until high-level workflow tools replace them.
Diagram node IDs containing codewiki_* are component identifiers, not agent-facing tool names.
open_questions: Exact schema and implementation order for wiki_runtime and wiki_state graph lenses must be planned next.
Whether roadmap display IDs/epochs should be added remains a separate unapproved planning/decision topic.
non_goals: Do not implement board/TUI UX in this decision.
Do not implement full parallel worker spawning before Brain lease, claims, execution graph, and escalation safeguards.
Do not make the graph canonical truth.
Do not add a generic wiki_maintain/fix-all tool.
risks: High-risk daemon automation can create hidden side effects if implemented before idempotency, artifact claims, validation gates, and escalation routing.
Changing tool names requires careful compatibility and staged migration from current low-level tools.
